summary: Learn business model innovation with Canvas tools, monetization strategy, and pilot planning. Build a board-ready model and action plan.
lede: Business innovation training helps professionals assess and redesign business models using customer evidence and structured experiments. It is for strategy, product, business development and innovation professionals who need to test commercial choices in operating conditions. Participants map value propositions and revenue logic, identify risky assumptions, design low-cost demand experiments, and assess channel, partner and delivery options using the Business Model Canvas and Lean Startup methods.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who need to redesign, test, and communicate business model choices in real operating conditions.
prerequisites: You should bring a laptop, a willingness to work on a real business model challenge, and access to any non-confidential market or customer information you can share safely during exercises. A basic understanding of strategy, offer design, or commercial operations will help you apply the tools faster.
